Attribution caveats are recorded in each row's notes: (a) Lee trailing-quarter columns (Q2-Q4 2024) are attributed to the Q1 2025 / Q4 2025 PDFs by inference from the result listing; Q4 2024 NNN rent appears as $13.48 in one edition and $13.52 in another (both written); (b) the CBRE big-box set is attributed to the 2024 Big-Box review by content inference (the summary also listed the Q4 2023 Figures page); (c) the NJBIZ CBRE Q2 article is undated in results and its Q2 2025 assignment comes from search context; (d) Lee Q2 2025 sales-volume sentence literally reads 'finished Q1 at $1.1B' inside the Q2 report. Custom metric names used beyond the vocabulary: asking_rent_growth_yoy, asking_rent_growth_qoq, rent_growth_qoq, vacancy_rate_change_yoy, taking_rent_psf, construction_starts_sf, lease_count_over_100k, sublease_leasing_sf, sublease_share_of_leasing, sublet_available_sf, free_rent_months (unit months), avg_months_on_market (unit months).
